relevance: A result is relevant only when its canonical URL matches a labelled URL prefix and its extracted evidence contains every normalized required-evidence term. No-result tasks are correct only with zero returned results and an explicit no-result state.
officialPreference: When a judgement-2 official URL exists it must precede non-official substitutes.
citation: The quote must equal the exact UTF-16 source slice, bind the canonical URL, result ID, extraction ID and source-body hash, and remain within offsets.
duplicates: Canonical URL aliases and materially identical pages form one cluster; distinct sellers, offers, versions, units, locations and conflicting evidence do not.
latency: Measure end-to-end client wall time in staging at least three times per profile; report median, p50, p95 and population variance. JavaScript fixtures are reported separately.
tuningProhibition: No query-ID, expected URL, labelled entity, expected term or per-task answer may be read by production ranking, retrieval, deduplication or source-selection code. Final holdout runs only after implementation freeze.
missingOrUnavailable: Unavailable external baselines and sources have null metrics and an exact reason; they are never scored as zero or invented.
